name: Chloé Clover
source:
A graceful lady with striking green eyes and blonde hair, whose origins and past are entirely unknown.

Approaching her out of mere curiosity would be extremely dangerous.

“I wonder how proper it is to answer a question with another question.”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#kuroe]official website[/url]]
